data.body: LIVE INVESTIGATION + CODE TRACE (2026-06-05): The proposed fix (Phase-6/6a counter should read post-suppression/applied count) is REJECTED — it would mask the real defect. Evidence: (1) Code trace — the probe's $5 / 'match filter' value is taken in reconcile.py:~1011 AFTER the inbound differ's bidirectional suppression (_ib_suppressed is dropped INSIDE compute_inbound_mutations, reconcile.py:947-963, never appended to 'mutations'). So the counter already measures the post-suppression DISPATCH set, which on a true no-op pass should be 0. It is the correct convergence metric. (2) reconcile.py:~970 documents a prior IDENTICAL 'Phase 6 idempotency churn' caused by inbound EDIT mutations that were emitted-but-silently-dropped at apply (bug b859) — precedent that 'computed>0, applied=0' is a differ EMISSION/convergence defect, not a counter artifact. (3) Reframed root cause: the 5 'local-wins' fields (description/priority/assignee/label/status) on the Phase-3-contended scaffold are RE-EMITTED by the inbound differ every pass despite producing no net state change — a field-equality NON-CONVERGENCE bug in the plateau/normalization family (cf commits 506acbac45 rstrip-aware comparison, 82b7fb2fe1 ticket_type exclusion, a06c local-intent label gating). Changing the counter to applied_count would let a genuinely non-converged pass spuriously pass (applied<computed in any deferring mode). (4) Live read-only reconcile-check run today (worktree, exit 0) could NOT reproduce the scaffold scenario (FIELD-PROBE-N tickets are transient to a mutating probe run) and showed worktree binding drift (963/963 orphaned) unrepresentative of production. NEXT STEP: this is a differ field-comparison convergence bug, fixed in inbound_differ/outbound_differ field-equality normalization for those 5 field types — NOT in the probe counter. Pinpointing the exact failing comparison requires a controlled e2e probe Phase-6a run (mutates live Jira). Keeping OPEN; do not patch the counter. Original title is now misleading — the defect is differ non-convergence surfaced BY a correct counter.
